headline: Sent $22,707.84 Sheehan High School door project and financial reports for final approval.
summary: Staff reported a projected surplus of $749,733 and recommended two more studies for New Wallingford High School: an enrollment study and a geotechnical analysis. The cafeteria reported a loss of $-37,099 for August and September. The Dag stop elevator is approaching completion, and Lyman Hall High School runway repairs should be finished by the end of the month.
decisions: Sent the financial reports 4.1.1 - 4.1.4 to the full Board for approval.
Sent the $22,707.84 transfer for Sheehan High School doors to the full Board for approval.
Sent the cafeteria reports 4.2.1 - 4.2.5 to the full Board for approval.

decision_evidence.quote: The consensus of the Operations Committee was to send the Financial Reports (4.1.1 - 4.1.4) to the full Board for approval.
The consensus of the Operations Committee was to send the $22,707.84 transfer for the Sheehan High School doors to the full Board for approval.
The consensus of the Operations Committee was to send the Cafeteria Reports (4.2.1 - 4.2.5) to the full Board for approval.
